primary_metrics.name: normalized_replication_recall_auc
primary_metrics.definition: Trapezoidal area under cumulative recall of the four frozen ADNI3-selected candidates that independently pass the prespecified directional component tests and Holm family-wise correction in ADNI1/GO/2.

primary_metrics.name: heldout_chain_evidence_ndcg
primary_metrics.definition: Full-ranking normalized discounted cumulative gain using heldout_chain_evidence_score as the non-negative relevance gain.

continuous_evidence.name: heldout_chain_evidence_score
continuous_evidence.definition: min(50, -log10(max(a_path_p, b_path_p, sobel_p))) for an estimable candidate; zero for a non-estimable candidate. This weakest-link score is direction-agnostic and requires all three mediation components to be strong.

feedback.supported: candidate is estimable and a_path_p, b_path_p, and sobel_p are each below 0.05 in the already executed ADNI1/GO/2 batch
feedback.inconclusive: candidate is estimable but does not meet the frozen weakest-link nominal threshold
feedback.contradicted: not used because no direction is public for the full 210-candidate universe

comparison.test: one-sided exact paired sign-flip test on each primary metric
comparison.multiplicity: Holm correction across the six baseline comparisons separately for each primary metric
comparison.confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap interval for paired mean difference

clear_sota_rule: NeuroDiscovery must exceed every baseline on both primary metrics. For every metric-baseline pair, the paired mean difference and its 95% bootstrap lower bound must be positive and the Holm-adjusted one-sided exact sign-flip P value must be below 0.05. If no registered candidate independently replicates, the recall metric is non-identifiable and clear SOTA cannot be claimed.
